translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Ubbaappe Aad'd'iyaawe Oonee?
Aa kaalliyaawanttu Yesuusakko he wode yiide, «Saluwaa kawutetsaan ubbaappe aad'd'iyaawe oonee?» yaageeddino.
Yesuusi itti guutsa na'aa s'eesi unttunttu giddon essiide, hawaadan yaageedda;
«Taani hinttenttoo tumuwaa oday; S'oossaakko hinttenttu simmiide, guutsa naanaadan hanana d'ayooppe, saluwaa kawutetsaa ubbakka gelanaw danddaykkita.
Simmi ha guutsa na'aadan, barena kawushshiyaa ooninne saluwaa kawutetsaan ubbaappe aad'd'iyaawaa.
K'ay hawaa mala na'aa ta suntsaan mokkiyaa ooninne taana mokkee.
Shin taana ammaniyaa ha guutsa naanaappe ittuwaa baletsiyaa ooninne, gaac'c'iyaa wogga wos'aa bare k'ood'iyaan k'achchiide, abbaa c'iimmuwaan mitettiyaawe aw lo"a.
D'uboo Gaaso Gidiyaawaa
«Alamii asaa d'ubbiyaa diraw, sa'aw aayyero; ayaw gooppe, d'ubbiyaabay yuussaa aggena; shin d'ubuu Aa gaasotaan yiyaa uraw aayyero.

«Neena kushii woy ne gedii neena baletsooppe, neeppe k'ans's'a ola; neeni laa"u kushiyaannanne laa"u gediyaanna med'inaa tamaan olettiyaawaappe wobba woy duus'a kushiyaanna med'inaa de'uwaa geliyaawe new lo"a.
K'ay ne ayfii neena baletsooppe, neeppe wooc'a kessa ola; neeni laa"u ayifiyaana Gaannamiyaa tamaan olettiyaawaappe itti ayifiyaana med'inaa de'uwaa geliyaawe new lo"a.

«Hinttenttu ha guutsatuwaappe ittuwaanne kad'enna mala, hinttentta naagite; ayaw gooppe, taani hinttenttoo oday; saluwaan unttunttu kiitanchchatuu ubbaa wode, saluwaan de'iyaa ta Aabbu sintsaan de'iino.
Ayaw gooppe, taani, Asaa Na'ay, bayeeddawaa ashshanaw yaad.
Bayeedda Dorssaa Leemisuwaa
«Itti asaw s'eetu dorssatuu de'iyaawanttuppe ittuu bayooppe, udduppu tammanne udduppunuwaa deriyaan aggiide, he bayeeddawaa koyyanaw beennee? Hinttenttu waagiitee?
Taani hinttenttoo tumuwaa gay; I demmooppe, bayibeenna udduppu tammanne udduppu dorssatuwaappe aatsiide, he itti dorssaan nashettee.
Hewaadankka, saluwaan de'iyaa hinttenttu Aabbu ha guutsatuwaappe ittuu bayanawaakka koyyenna.
Bayzzeedda Asaw Ootsanaw Bessiyaabaa
«Ne ishay neena naak'k'ooppe, neerekka aakko baade, Aa naak'uwaa aw oda; I newaa sisooppe, ne ishaa balaappe zaaraadda.
Shin I newaa sisennaan is's'ooppe, laa"u woy heezzu markkay markkattowaan yewuu ubbay tumattiyaa diraw, hara itti woy laa"u asaa neenanna ittippe afa.
I unttunttubaa sisennaan is's'ooppe, ubbabaa ammaniyaa asaw oda; K'ay ammaniyaa Asay giyaawaakka I sisennaan is's'ooppe, ammanenna asaadaaninne k'aras'aa shiishshiyaa asaadan Aa payda.
«Taani hinttenttoo tumuwaa gay; neeni sa'aan hano goowe ubbay saluwaan S'oossaa sintsaan hanana; shin neeni sa'aan hanoppo geeddawe saluwankka hanenna.
«K'aykka taani hinttenttoo oday; hintteppe laa"u uray sa'aan S'oossaa woossiyaawaan ay yewuwaaninne itti wozanaa gidooppe, saluwaan de'iyaa ta Aabbu hewaa hinttenttoo immana.
Ayaw gooppe, laa"u uray woy heezzu uray ta suntsaan shiik'iyaasaan, taani hewaan unttunttu gidduwaan de'ay» yaageedda.
Atto Giyaawaa
P'es'iroosi; he wode Yesuusakko yiide, «Godaw, ta ishay taana aappu kaala naak'k'ooppe taani aw atto gaanaw bessii? Laappunuwaa gakkanaw naak'k'ineeyee?» yaagiide Aa oochcheedda.
Yesuusi zaariide Aa, «Gidenna, taani neena laappun tammu kaala laappunuwaa gayippe attin, laappunuwaa s'alalaa giikke.
«Ayaw gooppe, saluwaa kawutetsay bare k'oomatuwaanna miishshaa heetettanaw k'oppeedda kaatiyaa bessee.
He kaatii miishshaa heetettanaw doommeedda wode, daro miiloone biraa ac'uu de'iyaa itti bitaniyaa aakko aheeddino.
Shin he k'oomaw ac'uwaa c'iggiyaawe d'ayina, Aa goday he ac'uwaa c'igganaw, Aa machchattanne inne Aa naanay, k'ay aw de'iyaa ubbabay zal"ettana mala, Aa azazeedda.
Hewaa diraw, k'oomay bare godaa sintsaan gulbbatiide, ‹Ta godaw, hayya godo guutsa wodiyaa naagaarikkii; taani new ubbabaakka c'iggana yaagiide Aa woosseedda.›
Aa goday aw k'arettiide, Aa yeddi aggeedda; Aa ac'uwaakka aw maari aggeedda.
«Shin he k'oomay kesiide, bare laggetsaa k'oomatuwaappe ittuu bareppe s'eetu biraa santtimiyaa tal"eeddawaanna gakettiide, ‹Ne bolla de'iyaa ta miishshaa c'igga› yaagi oyk'k'iide, Aa c'uulleedda.
«Yaatina he Aa laggetsaa k'oomay Aa sintsaan gulbbatiide, ‹Ha"i tayishay guutsa wodiyaa naagaarikkii; taani new ubbabaakka c'iggana› yaagiide Aa woosseedda.
«Shin is's'i akki biide, Aa laggetsay he ac'uwaa k'ans's'ana gakkanaw, k'asho golle gelisseedda.
Hewaa diraw, Aa laggetsaa k'oomatuu hewaa be'iide, daro yiloteeddino; barenttu godaakko biide, I ootseedda ubbabaa aw odeeddino.
«Hewaappe guyyiyaan, goday he k'oomaa s'eesiide, ‹Ha iita k'oomaw, neeni taana woosseedda diraw, taani he ac'uwaa ubbaa new maaraa aggaad.
Taani new he ac'uwaa maareeddawaadan, neenikka ne laggetsaa k'oomaw maaranaw bessennee?› yaageedda.
Hewaappe simmiide aw daro hank'k'ettiide, bare ac'uwaa ubbaa I c'iggi wurssana gakkanaw, pas'a kaa'ettana mala, k'asho golle gelisseedda.
«Hinttenttu huup'iyaan huup'iyaan hinttenttu ishaw wozanaappe atto gaana d'ayooppe, he goday bare k'oomaa ootseeddawaadan, saluwaan de'iyaa ta Aabbukka hinttentta hewaadan ootsana» yaageedda.
